summary: GDS Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on April 30, 2026, announcing that it submitted its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, to the SEC. The press release also provides details on accessing the report and company background. This is a routine filing of an annual report by a foreign private issuer under the Exchange Act. No special situation such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or activist campaign is mentioned. The filing does not contain any transaction, strategic review, or corporate action; it is purely an annual disclosure obligation.
